scenarios.title: A W3D nested in a BIG archive opens as a subject
scenarios.evidence: the archive itself opens, but the extension exposes no command or URI shape that names an entry inside it — «data/editor/molds/bowl.w3d» is unreachable from outside the page, and inside the page the archive stage reads an entry’s bytes into a hex pane rather than opening it as a subject. The host route exists and Electron uses it; this product does not wire it, so nested opening is absent here (wiring missing, blocks 13–14)

scenarios.title: A VXL without its sidecar reports a leak-free diagnostic
scenarios.evidence: the model opened without its sidecar, the host raised x3.host/companion-unavailable, and the 1 diagnostic line(s) carry no drive letter, UNC path, ${FILE_URL} URL or home directory
